business_rules: /list-sensors warns rather than errors — empty list is a soft default.
Diagnostic metadata is always present so the agent can see where lookup landed.
behavior.summary: After registry.Lookup resolves the project root, the script attempts to read running_sensors.json. If absent, it emits a warn Signal carrying metadata.registry_path metadata.registry_source metadata.registry_exists=false metadata.entries=[].

description: Discovery variation: /list-sensors with no running_sensors.json file on disk emits a warn Signal whose metadata.registry_exists=false; this typically indicates a wrong cwd or that no /start-sensor has ever run in this project.

evidence.rationale: Registry-absent branch emits the warn Signal.

expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has one warn Signal with diagnostic metadata fields.

name: Warn when registry file is absent (wrong cwd or never-started)

trigger.summary: Agent invokes /list-sensors from a project root that has no .harness/runtime/running_sensors.json.
